title: Pickin
subtitle: A Photo Selection Gallery Built Around How Indonesian Photographers Already Work
description: Pickin is a photo selection gallery for photographers in Indonesia. Clients open a link, tap a heart on the photos they want, and send their picks; the photographer receives a clean list of file names. Photos stay in the photographer's own Google Drive, and the whole loop, from sharing the gallery to delivering edits, runs through WhatsApp.

content.label: The Problem
content.content: After a shoot, choosing photos usually means sending a Drive folder, waiting for screenshots or a list of file names typed by hand, then matching them up one by one. Clients get lost in folders, and photographers lose time on admin instead of editing.

content.label: The Approach
content.content: Remove every step that isn't choosing. Clients don't log in or install anything: they open a link, tap a heart, and send. Photographers don't upload again, because the gallery reads straight from Google Drive, and the hand-off happens in WhatsApp, where the conversation already lives.

content.label: Mobile First
content.content: Most clients open the link on their phone, often on a weak connection. The gallery, picking flow, and plan details are designed to read and work comfortably on a small screen first.

content.label: Pricing
content.content: No subscription. Every photographer starts free, then pays once per gallery in rupiah via QRIS, only when a gallery needs more photos, a longer active period, or no branding. All plans include revisions, a results tab, and CSV export.
